svg.title: STAKEOUT / CORNERS AND ROAD WIDTHS
svg.text: VALIER CORP / PERSONAL DIMENSION
STAKEOUT / CORNERS AND ROAD WIDTHS
Temporary marker coordinates only / no marker material, game command or world placement is implied
CITY-LOCAL NW ORIGIN | +X EAST | +Z SOUTH | CIVIL Y0 = FUTURE WALKABLE SURFACE S
ALL BOUNDS INCLUSIVE / NO WORLD ANCHOR OR SURVEYED Y / CIVIL DESIGN, NOT GAME-TESTED
BLUE = planned / earlier structure | OCHRE = this order | GOLD = temporary caps | DASH = hall reservation
N
Start with the whole footprint
Mark city corners (0,0), (875,0), (0,875), (875,875). These are last
corner-block centers; 876 blocks span each axis inclusively.
Then mark the northwest phase
P1 last corner is (395,395). Its east border road is V04 X384..395 and
south border H04 Z384..395.
12 blocks, not 11
For each street k: first transverse block 96k; last transverse block
96k+11. Mark both edges. The next road begins at 96(k+1).
No half-block marker required
The mathematical centerline is 96k+5.5. Use the two center blocks
96k+5 and +6 when marking a center reference.
Northwest and whole-city lists
CSV stake lists use 24-block intervals plus corner controls, with
shared marker positions deduplicated and multiple labels kept.
Preserve plot reservations
Retain parcel and hall corner stakes from the masterplan. HQ uses
its explicit odd-size exception. No permanent civil block enters a hall
reservation.
